rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose pattern for one additional item or quantity, as in 多一塊蛋糕 for another slice of cake.

example.english: I want to eat another slice of cake.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoi3 sik6 do1 jat1 faai3 daan6 gou1

rows.note: Use this for one extra of the same kind; use 另一 + CL when you mean a different one.

example.english: I want another iced lemon tea.
example.traditional: 我想再要多一杯凍檸茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoi3 jiu3 do1 jat1 bui1 dung3 ling4 caa4

rows.note: Use this when the new one is different from the current one; use 多 + 一 + CL for an additional one of the same kind.

example.english: This photo isn't nice; let's take another one.
example.traditional: 呢張相唔靚，影另一張啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 m4 leng3 jing2 ling6 jat1 zoeng1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a different or alternative item, as in 另一個方法 for another way to do something.

example.english: This method doesn't work; let's try another way.
example.traditional: 呢個方法唔得，我哋試另一個方法啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 dak1 ngo5 dei6 si3 ling6 jat1 go3 fong1 faat3 laa1
